spans.s: यौवत n. 1. An assemblage of young women; 2. the state of being a youthful woman, अहो विबुधयौवतं वहसि तन्वि पृथ्वीगता Git.G.x.
यौवन n. 1. Youth, prime of life, puberty, निवेशयंते प्रमदाः सयौवनाः Rt.i.7, R.i.8; 2. a number of young people, especially women.
यौवन-दर्प m. pride of youth, rashness common to youth.
यौवन-लक्षण n. 1. characteristic of youth; 2. charm, loveliness; 3. the female breast.
यौवराज्य n. The office of a Yuvarāja or heir-apparent.
